title: ModuleTaskToolBrokerAdapter
responsibility: Broker contract discovery and exact assigned-file operations for a trusted task host.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskToolBrokerAdapter.scope
inputs.description: Trusted host-provided canonical task root, exact file grants, committed contract snapshot, sealed CLI directory and isolated scratch.

inputs.name: readContract.unitId
inputs.description: Committed unit identifier, never a source path or command.

inputs.name: readAssigned.path
inputs.description: Exact canonical relative path in the task grant.

inputs.name: writeAssigned
inputs.description: Exact granted path, current content digest and bounded UTF-8 replacement.

outputs.name: readContract
outputs.description: Identity, responsibility, contract fields, declared dependency references and consumers without source/test paths.

outputs.name: listContracts
outputs.description: Unit identities, kinds and responsibilities from the pinned committed snapshot.

outputs.name: readAssigned
outputs.description: Exact assigned regular-file UTF-8 content and its digest.

outputs.name: writeAssigned
outputs.description: Digest of the replacement after optimistic concurrency and file checks.

errors.name: untrusted scope, invalid input, stale hash, unsafe path or CLI failure
errors.description: Reject access or modification; no arbitrary command or unassigned file access is supported. Race resistance requires a trusted exclusively owned workspace.
